title: 3 Nuclear Stocks with MASSIVE Upside Ahead (Most Aren't Ready)
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Kieran Francis of the Fintech Channel for a nuclear-sector outlook and his three favorite picks. Francis argues nuclear fundamentals keep improving while prices fall - US electricity demand is forecast to roughly double by 2030 on AI data-center load, but long reactor build times (6-8 years, longer in the US) mean revenue lags recognition, punishing impatient investors; last year's SMR darlings like SMR and Oklo are down hardest on overhype plus small-cap volatility. His picks: Constellation Energy (CEG), the largest US clean-energy provider with multi-billion-dollar contracts from Meta and Microsoft and a ~22 P/E, a 'boring Buffett stock' that is already profitable; Centrus Energy (LEU), the only US producer of HALEU fuel for small modular reactors - a bottleneck pseudo-monopoly play with 18% YoY revenue growth but binary moonshot risk ('huge run-up or go to zero'); and the VanEck Uranium and Nuclear ETF (NLR) as the broad, 15-year buy-and-hold option - though he warns not to pair it with the individual names since CEG is ~9% and LEU ~5% of the ETF. Bridget notes analysts still carry bullish targets on LEU ($215, cut from $314 to $264) even as retail sentiment sours - a setup Francis likes as a bet against sentiment. She adds CEG (May 5) and LEU to her paper-trading watchlist. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: 'Centrist Energy' = Centrus Energy (LEU); 'Ollo' = Oklo (OKLO, no call - pullback context only).
